sentences.text: Mongolia is a big country in Asia.
Many people there are nomads.
Nomads are people who move from place to place.
They do not live in one house all year.
Their life is very interesting and different from life in a city.
The traditional home for a Mongolian nomad is a 'ger'.
A ger is a round tent.
It is easy to build and to take down.
This is important because nomads move many times.
They must find new grass for their animals.
Animals are very important.
Families have sheep, goats, and horses.
Horses are special in Mongolian culture.
People can ride them for long distances.
In the past, life was simple but hard.
Today, things are changing.
Many nomadic families now have modern technology.
They use solar panels for electricity.
With electricity, they can have lights and watch TV.
They also have mobile phones.
Phones help them talk to family and friends who are far away.
Life is a little easier now.
Some young people want a different life.
They move to the city to study or work.
Cities are bigger than the countryside.
They have more schools and jobs.
But many people still love the nomadic way of life.
They want to keep their traditions.
They teach their children about the old ways.
Today, Mongolian culture is a mix of old and new.
Nomads can drive a truck, but they still ride horses.
They can watch the news on a phone, but they still look at the stars at night.
They adapt and change, but their connection to the land and their animals is still very strong.
